message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The current best numerical point is the 16-bit linear LUT (SQNR 82.1 dB) but it costs 1584.6 um^2. Decreasing precision has 2 legal unvisited neighbors and should reduce area while retaining linear interpolation; the 14-bit linear LUT already gives 72.8 dB at 1346.5 um^2, so a one-level precision decrease is the best balance of mapped area and still-high SQNR."}
